notes.title: DEMO Hotfix for Widescreen Displays
notes.content: [p]The [b]Arcade FC DEMO[/b] now (better) supports [b]widescreen displays[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]Windowed mode[/h3][p]You may toggle windowed and full-screen mode with [b]F11 [/b]for even more flexibility.[/p][p][/p][h3]Camera Zoom[/h3][p]Adjust the camera zoom with [b]PAGE-UP/DOWN[/b] ([b]HOME[/b] to reset) to zoom in or out and adjust the game to your screen resolution and preferences.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Thanks to all the players who pointed this out![/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
